title: Transform to Chessboard
key_insight: 合法棋盘只有两种行模式和两种列模式，且互为取反；交换次数等于不在位的元素数/2
approach:
1. 检查是否只有两种行模式且互为取反
2. 检查行列数量差不超过1
3. 分别计算行和列的最小交换次数
4. 偶数维度取两种方案的最小值
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def movesToChessboard(self, board: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        n = len(board)
        for r in board:
            if sum(r[i] ^ board[0][i] for i in range(n)) not in (0, n): return -1
        rowSum = sum(board[0])
        colSum = sum(board[i][0] for i in range(n))
        if not (n//2 <= rowSum <= (n+1)//2): return -1
        if not (n//2 <= colSum <= (n+1)//2): return -1
        rowSwap = sum(board[0][i] != (i % 2) for i in range(n))
        colSwap = sum(board[i][0] != (i % 2) for i in range(n))
        if n % 2:
            if rowSwap % 2: rowSwap = n - rowSwap
            if colSwap % 2: colSwap = n - colSwap
        else:
            rowSwap = min(rowSwap, n - rowSwap)
            colSwap = min(colSwap, n - colSwap)
        return (rowSwap + colSwap) // 2

title: Minimum Distance Between BST Nodes
key_insight: BST中序遍历得到有序序列，最小差值一定在相邻元素之间
approach:
1. 中序遍历BST
2. 维护前驱节点值
3. 计算当前值与前驱的差
4. 更新最小差值
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def minDiffInBST(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        self.prev = -float('inf')
        self.ans = float('inf')
        def inorder(node):
            if not node: return
            inorder(node.left)
            self.ans = min(self.ans, node.val - self.prev)
            self.prev = node.val
            inorder(node.right)
        inorder(root)
        return self.ans

title: K-th Smallest Prime Fraction
key_insight: 二分分数值，统计小于mid的分数个数来定位第k小
approach:
1. 二分答案区间[0,1]
2. 对每个mid统计小于mid的分数数量
3. 同时记录最大的那个分数
4. 根据count与k的关系调整区间
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def kthSmallestPrimeFraction(self, arr: List[int], k: int) -> List[int]:
        n = len(arr)
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.0
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) / 2
            count = 0
            maxFrac = [0, 1]
            j = 1
            for i in range(n):
                while j < n and arr[i] / arr[j] > mid: j += 1
                count += n - j
                if j < n and arr[i] * maxFrac[1] > maxFrac[0] * arr[j]:
                    maxFrac = [arr[i], arr[j]]
            if count == k: return maxFrac
            elif count < k: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid

title: Valid Tic-Tac-Toe State
key_insight: 验证井字棋状态需检查X和O的数量关系以及是否双方都赢
approach:

2. X数量等于O或比O多1

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def validTicTacToe(self, board: List[str]) -> bool:
        xc = sum(row.count('X') for row in board)
        oc = sum(row.count('O') for row in board)
        def wins(p):
            for i in range(3):
                if all(board[i][j]==p for j in range(3)): return True
                if all(board[j][i]==p for j in range(3)): return True
            if board[0][0]==board[1][1]==board[2][2]==p: return True
            if board[0][2]==board[1][1]==board[2][0]==p: return True
            return False
        if oc > xc or xc > oc + 1: return False
        if wins('X') and xc == oc: return False
        if wins('O') and xc > oc: return False
        return True

title: Split Array With Same Average
key_insight: 两组平均值相等等价于存在子集和为total*k/n，用背包或折半枚举
approach:
1. 问题转化为是否存在大小为k的子集和为sum*k/n
2. 对每个元素减去平均值，问题变为子集和为0
3. 用折半搜索枚举前后半部分
4. 检查是否有互补的子集
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def splitArraySameAverage(self, nums: List[int]) -> bool:
        n = len(nums)
        total = sum(nums)
        nums = [x * n - total for x in nums]
        half = n // 2
        left = set()
        for i in range(1, 1 << half):
            s = sum(nums[j] for j in range(half) if i & (1 << j))
            if s == 0: return True
            left.add(s)
        rNums = nums[half:]
        rLen = n - half
        for i in range(1, 1 << rLen):
            s = sum(rNums[j] for j in range(rLen) if i & (1 << j))
            if s == 0: return True
            if i != (1 << rLen) - 1 and -s in left: return True
        return False

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def pruneTree(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        if not root: return None
        root.left = self.pruneTree(root.left)
        root.right = self.pruneTree(root.right)
        if root.val == 0 and not root.left and not root.right: return None
        return root

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def mostCommonWord(self, paragraph: str, banned: List[str]) -> str:
        import re
        from collections import Counter
        words = re.findall(r'\w+', paragraph.lower())
        ban = set(banned)
        cnt = Counter(w for w in words if w not in ban)
        return cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

4. 满足条件则计数

title: Positions of Large Groups
key_insight: 扫描字符串找连续相同字符的段，长度>=3的记录起止位置
approach:
1. 双指针扫描连续相同字符段
2. 记录每段的起止位置
3. 长度>=3的加入结果
4. 返回结果列表

title: Masking Personal Information
key_insight: 判断是邮箱还是电话号码，分别按规则掩码
approach:
1. 判断输入是邮箱(@)还是电话号码
2. 邮箱：首尾字符+***+@+域名，全部小写
3. 电话：提取数字，按长度加国家代码
4. 格式化输出

title: Flipping an Image
key_insight: 先水平翻转再取反，等价于对称位置XOR 1后交换
approach:
1. 对每行进行水平翻转
2. 然后对每个元素取反(0变1,1变0)
3. 可以合并为一步：交换对称位置并XOR

title: Find And Replace in String
key_insight: 从后往前替换避免位移影响索引
approach:
1. 按索引从大到小排序操作
2. 对每个操作检查source是否匹配
3. 匹配则替换为target
4. 从后往前保证索引不变

title: Sum of Distances in Tree
key_insight: 第一次DFS计算根的距离和，第二次DFS通过父子关系推导其他节点
approach:
1. 建树，第一次DFS计算每个子树大小和根的距离和
2. 第二次DFS换根：子节点距离和=父距离和-子树大小+(n-子树大小)
3. 即ans[child]=ans[parent]-count[child]+(n-count[child])

title: Image Overlap
key_insight: 枚举所有可能的偏移量，统计每个偏移下重叠的1的数量
approach:
1. 收集两个矩阵中1的坐标
2. 枚举A中每个1与B中每个1的偏移
3. 用哈希表统计每个偏移量出现次数
4. 最大次数即为答案

title: Rectangle Overlap
key_insight: 两个矩形重叠等价于x和y方向上的投影区间都有交集
approach:
1. x方向：max(x1,x3)<min(x2,x4)
2. y方向：max(y1,y3)<min(y2,y4)
3. 两个条件同时满足则重叠

title: New 21 Game
key_insight: dp[x]表示得到x分的概率，用滑动窗口维护最近maxPts个dp值的和
approach:
1. dp[0]=1，dp[x]=sum(dp[x-maxPts:x])/maxPts
2. 当x>=k时停止抽取
3. 用滑动窗口优化求和
4. 答案=sum(dp[k:n+1])

title: Push Dominoes
key_insight: 找到每个多米诺骨牌受到的最近左力和右力，比较大小决定方向
approach:
1. 从左到右计算右推力的距离
2. 从右到左计算左推力的距离
3. 比较每个位置的两个力
4. 力大的方向决定倒向

title: Similar String Groups
key_insight: 两个字符串相似(最多两处不同)则连边，用并查集求连通分量数
approach:
1. 判断两个字符串是否相似(差异<=2)
2. 枚举所有字符串对
3. 相似则用并查集合并
4. 返回连通分量数

title: Magic Squares In Grid
key_insight: 枚举所有3x3子矩阵，检查是否为魔方阵(1-9各出现一次且行列对角线和为15)
approach:
1. 枚举所有3x3子矩阵的左上角
2. 检查是否包含1-9各一次
3. 检查每行每列每对角线和是否为15
4. 满足条件则计数
